name: Upward Bound (Virginia Tech)
what_you_do: Get free tutoring, college prep workshops, career ideas and college trips during the school year. You also get a summer program of up to six weeks on the Virginia Tech campus.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 at the listed high schools. They are Floyd, Franklin County, Giles, Narrows, Bassett, Magna Vista, E.C. Glass, Heritage, Martinsville, Pulaski, Salem, William Fleming and Patrick Henry. When first picked, you must be 13 to 19. You must have low income, be first in your family to go to college, or be at risk in school.
pay_detail: Free. The page says students get paid for participating but does not give an amount.
duration: School year (weekly tutoring, monthly events) plus up to six weeks in summer
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Use the application form for your school.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form that matches your school (Roanoke City, Salem, or Southwest Virginia list). A Spanish PDF application is also posted.
notes: Only for the listed schools, so Blacksburg and Christiansburg students are not on the list. Ask the TRIO office if your school can be added. Federal income and first-generation rules apply.
